subject.title: Tailscale serve mode lacks optional secondary authentication

question: Should OpenClaw accept `gateway.auth.requireTailscaleSharedSecret` as the public opt-in contract for requiring token/password auth on top of verified Tailscale Serve identity?
rationale: The issue changes Gateway authentication semantics and adds public config surface, which repository policy treats as security- and compatibility-sensitive maintainer intent rather than an autonomous cleanup choice.

options.title: Approve Linked Layered Auth PR
options.body: Accept the token/password-only layered Tailscale Serve contract in the open PR after branch refresh and normal checks.

options.title: Narrow Or Redesign Contract
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers revise the policy around Tailscale identity, trusted-proxy semantics, warnings, and Control UI pairing.

options.title: Docs And Warnings Only
options.body: Do not add a new auth config key yet; improve docs/audit warnings around `allowTailscale` and recommend disabling it for shared-secret-only deployments.

recommendation.title: Approve Linked Layered Auth PR
recommendation.body: Accept the token/password-only layered Tailscale Serve contract in the open PR after branch refresh and normal checks.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the clearest available history across the relevant Gateway auth and Tailscale hardening surfaces.
